provincial.name: Saskatchewan Assured Income for Disability (SAID)
provincial.who: SK resident 18+, citizen/PR/refugee, low resources, significant permanent disability; Disability Impact Assessment
provincial.gives: Living Income benefit, Exceptional Needs benefits; earned income exemptions $7,500 single
provincial.notes: Rates restructured Sept 1 2026 (4 tiers to 2) per search snippet; page states no max amount.

provincial.name: Saskatchewan Income Support (SIS)
provincial.who: SK resident 18+, no/low income, citizen/PR/refugee, explored other options
provincial.gives: Basic $375/adult, shelter $615-675 single, plus health/safety, diet, heating extras (rates May 1 2026)
provincial.notes: Not disability-specific; gateway to Supplementary Health.

provincial.name: Saskatchewan Employment Incentive (SEI)
provincial.who: 18+, not on SIS/SAID, children 0-12 (13-17 w/ special circumstances) on CCB, earned income >= $500/mo, below family cap
provincial.gives: Up to $400-600/mo, Supplementary Health review, discounted bus passes in 7 municipalities
provincial.notes: Replaces Saskatchewan Employment Supplement (SES) per other pages; not disability-specific.

provincial.name: Saskatchewan Housing Benefit (SHB)
provincial.who: Renters paying 35%+ of income on shelter, assets < $300,000, under income limits; not on SIS/SAID
provincial.gives: Help with rent and utility costs
provincial.notes: Only verified via SRHS page (fetched): SRHS closed to new applicants 2018, benefits moved Aug 31 2026. SHB eligibility numbers from 211 search snippet, SHB page itself not fetched.

provincial.name: Saskatchewan Aids to Independent Living (SAIL)
provincial.who: SK resident with Health Services Number, referral from health professional, not covered by SGI/WCB/NIHB/Veterans
provincial.gives: Prosthetics, mobility aids, respiratory/oxygen, nutrition, compression garments; special benefits (ostomy, paraplegia, insulin pump, aids to blind)
provincial.notes: 14 sub-programs, some special-benefit rules. Hub also lists sail page under /residents/health/.../sail (not fetched).

provincial.name: Supplementary Health Benefits
provincial.who: SAID, SIS or SEI recipients, wards, certain care-home residents
provincial.gives: Extra health coverage (dental, vision, drugs, supplies)
provincial.notes: Fetch failed (certificate error); eligibility from search snippet only. Automatic via SAID/SIS/SEI.

provincial.name: Family Health Benefits
provincial.who: Low-income working families passing income test (Social Services decides)
provincial.gives: Children: dental, annual eye exam, glasses, ambulance, supplies, drugs; parents: eye exam, drugs with $100 deductible/35% copay

provincial.name: Special Support Program (drug plan)
provincial.who: Residents with high drug costs relative to income; not covered by NIHB/Veterans

provincial.name: Seniors' Drug Plan
provincial.who: 65+, SK health card, net income <= $81,633 (2027 coverage)

provincial.name: Seniors Income Plan (SIP)
provincial.who: 65+, permanent SK resident, receiving OAS/GIS, low income
provincial.gives: Up to $360/mo single ($325 each couple); $50 in special care home
provincial.notes: No application; automatic. Page dates inconsistent.

provincial.name: Autism Spectrum Disorder Individualized Funding (ASD-IF)
provincial.who: Child with ASD diagnosis, SK resident, one parent applies

provincial.name: Cognitive Disability Strategy (CDS) Support
provincial.who: Cognitive disability from early age with unmet need no other system supports
provincial.gives: Cognitive Disability Consultants and income-tested Cognitive Disability Benefit
provincial.notes: No age or dollar amounts published.

provincial.name: Respite for families of a child with intellectual disabilities
provincial.who: Parents/guardians of child accepted by Community Living Service Delivery, income-tested

provincial.name: Individualized Funding for Home Care
provincial.who: Qualify for home care support services, need long-term supportive care, can manage funding
provincial.gives: Self-managed funding for personal care and home management
provincial.notes: Regular SHA home care not separately fetched.

provincial.name: Adapt a Home for a Person with a Disability (Home Repair Program)
provincial.who: Owner/landlord with household member with housing-related disability, income under limits ($58,100 1-bedroom), assets <= $300,000
provincial.notes: Limits as of July 1 2026. Other Home Repair streams not fetched.

provincial.name: Employability Assistance for Persons with Disabilities (EAPD)
provincial.who: 16+, entitled to work, self-declared disability, approved career/service plan
provincial.gives: Funding for training, job-search and job-keeping supports; employer accommodation funding

provincial.name: Housing and Support for People with Intellectual Disabilities / Approved Private Service Homes
provincial.notes: Listed on hub; sub-pages not fetched.

provincial.name: Canada-Saskatchewan Grant for Services and Equipment for Students with Disabilities
provincial.who: Post-secondary student with permanent or persistent/prolonged disability, verified, in student aid
provincial.notes: Seen in search results only, not fetched. Overlaps federal Canada Student Grant for Students with Disabilities.

provincial.name: Accessible Parking Program (SaskAbilities / SGI)
provincial.gives: Parking placard for designated spaces; 25% provincial park entry discount pilot
provincial.notes: SGI page fetched but returned only nav text. Program run by SaskAbilities, not SGI. Eligibility from search snippets; saskabilities.ca page not fetched.

municipal.name: Regina Paratransit
